flowhelp.title: Setup & options — step help
flowhelp.intro_html: This page is meant to be opened from Hub Énergie itself: each section matches a step_id in the integration config or options flow. Text stays out of the main documentation scroll path unless you choose to come here.
flowhelp.link_convention_html: Anchor convention: initial wizard → #flow-step-<step_id>; post-setup Configure menu → #flow-step-options-<step_id> (for example options advanced_energy → #flow-step-options-advanced_energy).
flowhelp.footer_html: Full branch graph and step_id table: custom_components/hub_energie/docs/config-flow.md in GitLab. Main guided doc: Configuration on this site.
flowhelp.fieldguide_no_hint: No extra description in translations (see the label). Required vs optional follows Home Assistant defaults for this step.
